info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Events Ticketing Tickets Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Status Retrieval API allows users to access the current status of tickets for various events. This endpoint provides a seamless way for event organizers and ticketing platforms to monitor ticket availability, confirm statuses, and enhance customer experiences. Typical consumers include event management systems, ticketing websites, and customer support teams who require real-time ticket status information. By utilizing this API, developers can easily integrate ticket status functionalities into their applications, ensuring that users have the most up-to-date details for their ticketing needs.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of tickets in the system. It helps in understanding the progress and state of ticket-based workflows.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of tickets. This operation allows you to fetch the current status of tickets based on specified criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of tickets.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusRequest.description: A string representing the status of the tickets in the GET request body.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.title: Ticket Status Response

status.description: Indicates if the ticket operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the ticket status.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket operation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsStatusResponse.description: Response schema for retrieving the status of a ticket operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the ticket.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the ticket was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the ticket was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the ticket operation.

x-processing-time.description: The total time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request, measured from the moment the request was received until the response was sent.
